_about: Single source of truth for the scenario-study sensor profiles. Read by generators/generate_scenarios.py (datasets, SENSOR_PARAMETER_MATRIX.csv), generators/validate_scenarios.py and generators/plot_profiles.py. Source classes: VERIFIED = manufacturer document read in this study; DATASET = public dataset measurement; REFERENCE = published standard / engineering reference; ASSUMPTION = simulation assumption (not a device measurement).
round_note: Mode 2 network epoch = 1 h of environmental time for air, effluent and soil. The water stream keeps the unchanged MATLAB V2 KSPCB schedule (212 sampling dates -> 1000 rounds; rounds 1-500 simulated), so one water round is a schedule slot, not a fixed hour.

frame.app_header_layout: node_id 2 B, sequence 2 B, round 2 B, profile_id 1 B, flags 1 B (alarm, priority, report type), field-presence bitmap 2 B
frame.field_encoding: every field is a scaled 16-bit integer (value / scale); missing = 0xFFFF sentinel, never 0
frame.mac_phy_overhead_note: IEEE 802.15.4: PHY 6 B (preamble 4, SFD 1, PHR 1) + MAC 11 B (FCF 2, seq 1, dst PAN 2, dst 2, src 2, FCS 2) with 16-bit addresses and PAN-ID compression
frame.mode1_note: Mode 1 keeps the existing 4000-bit abstract packet of the validated RL-Hybrid model for every report

radio_reference.note: first-order radio model of the existing simulator (PeriyarModel.h); used only to compare sensing energy with radio energy

processing.note: MCU wake, read, scale and check thresholds; no compression or local aggregation beyond the round mean

water_quality.description: River water-quality monitoring (Periyar River, KSPCB data)
water_quality.sampling_note: in-situ sonde reading every 15 min, round value = carried KSPCB observation (sample-and-hold of daily grab samples)
water_quality.report_note: river parameters change over hours; 2-round periodic report, every round while an alarm is active

fields.name: temperature_C
fields.range_sensor: -55 to +125 degC; +/-0.5 degC from -10 to +85 degC

energy.note: max active current 1.5 mA, max 12-bit conversion 750 ms; V = 3.3 V chosen within 3.0-5.5 V

fields.name: pH
fields.hardware: glass pH electrode + digital interface circuit (Atlas Scientific EZO-pH class; datasheet not readable in this study)

energy.note: order-of-magnitude assumption for a powered pH interface board; replace with datasheet values

fields.name: conductivity_uScm
fields.resolution: 2 uS/cm (16-bit encoding step; KSPCB maximum 82362 uS/cm)
fields.hardware: conductivity probe + digital interface (Atlas EZO-EC class; datasheet not readable)

fields.name: TDS_mgL
fields.range_sensor: derived from conductivity on a real node
fields.hardware: computed from conductivity (TDS = k x EC); KSPCB values are laboratory measurements
fields.source: KSPCB River Periyar analysis reports Jan-Jul 2025 (MATLAB V2 data/consdata.xlsx)

energy.note: no extra sensor: derived from the EC reading

extension_fields.name: DO_mgL
extension_fields.valid_rule: 0 < DO <= 15 mg/L (about 2x saturation at 30 degC); other KSPCB-loader values are flagged invalid
extension_fields.hardware: optical or galvanic DO probe + interface (Atlas EZO-DO class; datasheet not readable)

excluded_fields.name: turbidity_NTU
excluded_fields.reason: all KSPCB workbook cells are '*' (turbidity meter out of order); no real observations, none fabricated

alarms.source: CPCB designated-best-use criteria, Class B (outdoor bathing): pH 6.5-8.5, https://cpcb.gov.in/water-quality-criteria/
CPCB criteria Class E (irrigation): EC max 2250 umhos/cm, https://cpcb.gov.in/water-quality-criteria/
CPCB criteria Class C: DO 4 mg/L or more, https://cpcb.gov.in/water-quality-criteria/ (extension field only)

industrial_effluent.sampling_note: 15-min samples; round value = mean of the four samples
industrial_effluent.report_note: continuous compliance monitoring: hourly report, alarm reports carry priority

fields.name: conductivity_uScm
fields.resolution: 2 uS/cm (16-bit encoding step; KSPCB maximum 82362 uS/cm)

energy.note: LED + photodiode with wiper not modelled

fields.name: COD_mgL
fields.hardware: UV-Vis spectral probe (SAC254 surrogate for COD/BOD)

energy.note: lamp + spectrometer cycle, shared by COD and BOD; multi-watt class device

fields.name: BOD_mgL
fields.range_sensor: estimated from the spectral probe (BOD5/BOD3 is a laboratory test)
fields.hardware: same spectral probe as COD (correlation model)

fields.name: NH3N_mgL
fields.hardware: ammonium ion-selective electrode with K+ compensation

alarms.source: Environment (Protection) Rules 1986 Schedule VI, inland surface water: pH 5.5-9.0, https://cpcb.gov.in/GeneralStandards.pdf
Schedule VI inland surface water: BOD (3 days at 27 degC) max 30 mg/L
Schedule VI inland surface water: COD max 250 mg/L
Schedule VI inland surface water: ammonical nitrogen (as N) max 50 mg/L

air_quality.description: Ambient air-quality monitoring (UCI Beijing multi-site hourly measurements, replayed)
air_quality.sampling_note: PM sensor woken 4x per hour (30 s warm-up each), gas sensors continuously biased and averaged; dataset gives one hourly value
air_quality.report_note: hourly averages are the reporting basis of the source network and of 1-h ambient limits

fields.name: PM25_ugm3
fields.range_sensor: effective 0-500 ug/m3, maximum >= 1000 ug/m3; consistency +/-10 ug/m3 (0-100), +/-10% (100-500)
fields.source: Plantower PMS5003 series data manual V2.3, https://cdn-shop.adafruit.com/product-files/3686/plantower-pms5003-manual_v2-3.pdf

energy.note: active current <= 100 mA at 5.0 V; stable data at least 30 s after wake-up (upper bound per sample; PM2.5 and PM10 share the cycle)

fields.name: PM10_ugm3
fields.valid_rule: >= 0; PM10 >= PM2.5 checked and flagged, not altered

energy.note: ISB potentiostat biased continuously; supply current not stated on the pages read; assumed 1 mA for the whole hour, per round not per sample

fields.name: NO2_ugm3
fields.range_sensor: 0-20 ppm; sensitivity -200 to -650 nA/ppm; t90 < 80 s

fields.name: SO2_ugm3
fields.range_sensor: 0-100 ppm; noise 5 ppb equivalent; t90 < 60 s

fields.name: O3_ugm3
fields.range_sensor: 0-20 ppm O3 (O3+NO2 sensor, NO2 subtracted); t90 < 80 s

fields.name: temperature_C
fields.range_sensor: -40 to 125 degC; SHT45 accuracy typ. +/-0.1 degC

energy.note: measurement current 320 uA typ (500 max); high-repeatability duration 6.9 typ / 8.3 max ms; 1.08-3.6 V

fields.name: RH_pct
fields.hardware: Sensirion SHT45 (same measurement); dataset RH derived from TEMP and DEWP (Magnus formula)

energy.note: pull-up and counter current, per round

alarms.source: India NAAQS 2009: PM2.5 60 ug/m3 (24 h); applied to the hourly value as a conservative screening trigger
India NAAQS 2009: PM10 100 ug/m3 (24 h); hourly screening
India NAAQS 2009: NO2 80 ug/m3 (24 h); hourly screening
India NAAQS 2009: SO2 80 ug/m3 (24 h); hourly screening

soil_monitoring.sampling_note: VWC, soil temperature and bulk EC every 30 min; pH and N/P/K once per 24 rounds
soil_monitoring.report_note: soil moisture changes over hours; 4-round periodic report, every round while an alarm is active, chemistry once per day

fields.name: VWC_pct
fields.hardware: capacitance/TDR soil-moisture probe (METER TEROS 12 class; datasheet not readable: HTTP 403)

energy.note: VWC, temperature and bulk EC come from one probe reading

fields.name: N_mgkg
fields.hardware: nitrate ISE / optical nutrient sensor (occasional; low-cost RS485 'NPK' probes have unverified accuracy)

energy.note: one reading gives N, P and K

mixed_environment.rule: nodes 1-10 (the real KSPCB station streams) are always water_quality; the remaining water slots and all other categories are drawn without replacement from nodes 11-200 with the assignment seed
